name: vocal-natural-light
status: convention, not auditioned; knob names UNVERIFIED
source: In The Mix lighter chain (vocal-chain.md 'Lighter chain' + §2)

chain.note: transparent: stop before the singer sounds lispy
narrow +6 dB sweep, cut the resonances found a few dB; HPF ~100 Hz (voice-dependent)
3-10 dB GR; medium-long attack keeps the start of each word; release recovers between words; output = input level
bring brightness back (stand-in for an exciter); blend by ear
